## Summary

Follow-up split from injurious-pugnacious-azurevase (c0f6-0fc9-fe48-41bc), the class-fix
for repo/config-root-derived-from-the-store-path. That ticket landed the behavior-preserving
`str(tracker)` subset (composer.py / composer_edit.py) and the `str()` half of the AST guard.
This ticket covers the DESIGN-JUDGMENT `realpath()`/`abspath()` subset it deliberately deferred,
because each site needs a per-site decision that is NOT behavior-preserving.

## The approved principle (operator-decided)

On a RELOCATED store (store outside the code checkout — the deployed MCP topology: code at
`/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`, store at `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets`), sites that compose a root
as `dirname(realpath/abspath(tracker))` may want one of TWO different roots:

1. Anything that reads `compose_config()` resolves the CODE repo root via the sanctioned
   resolver `config.repo_root_or_none()`. `rebar.toml` lives in the checkout, so reading it from
   the store's parent is the bug. (behavior-changing on a relocated store)
2. Git operations on the store's OWN repo keep the STORE root, routed through ONE shared seam
   `rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker)` and each carrying a documented `# repo-root-ok:`
   sanction. (behavior-preserving)

Divergence is prevented BY CONSTRUCTION: both resolutions go through a single named choke point
(`config.repo_root_or_none()` for the code root; `rebar._proc.store_repo_root()` for the store
root, marked `# repo-root-seam:`), and the AC#3 guard fails CI on any other direct spelling.

## Candidate sites (disposition per the principle)

CODE ROOT (via `config.repo_root_or_none()`; behavior-changing on a relocated store):
- src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:238 — `_sync_disabled(...)` -> `compose_config(root).sync.pull`.
- src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:249 — `tickets_branch(...)` -> `tickets.branch`.
- src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:374 — `_load_scratch` -> `compose_config(root).scratch.base_dir`.

STORE ROOT (via the shared seam `rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker)`; behavior-preserving,
`git -C <tracker>` on the store's OWN repo / attribution against it):
- src/rebar/_proc.py — `detached_child_cwd` (uses the seam directly; stdlib-only leaf home).
- src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py, compact_rebuild.py, compact_plan.py — authorship/attribution repo_root.
- src/rebar/_commands/fsck.py — dir-mismatch-hint repo_guess.
- src/rebar/_commands/fsck_tracker_health.py (×3) — store's own branch/remote for the health probe.
- src/rebar/_store/freshness.py:80 — `_remote_ref` store's own remote/branch for the staleness
  ancestry probe (a realpath()-wrapped member of this class, mirrors fsck's tracker-sync probe).

ALREADY SANCTIONED — out of this ticket's realpath/abspath scope (do NOT re-triage):
- src/rebar/_store/sync.py:305/307 — `tickets_branch/tickets_remote(dirname(str(tracker)))`, the
  `str()` variant, already carrying a `# repo-root-ok:` sanction (line 306) landed by the parent
  ticket c0f6-0fc9. Not a realpath()/abspath() member. Left untouched (also avoids collision with
  concurrent ticket baldish-regainable-steed).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC#1 — Each realpath()/abspath() config-read site (reads.py:238 sync.pull, :249
  tickets.branch, :374 scratch.base_dir) resolves `cfg_root` from the CODE repo root via
  `config.repo_root_or_none()`. VERIFY: `grep -n 'dirname' src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py`
  shows none of these three sites wraps `tracker` in `dirname(realpath/abspath(...))` for the
  config root any more (they call `repo_root_or_none()`); the three dispositions are enumerated
  in a ticket comment cited at completion. Because each fix changes relocated-store behavior, each
  is proven by a RED→GREEN oracle in `tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py`
  (`test_load_scratch_reads_scratch_under_the_code_root`,
  `test_ensure_fresh_resolves_sync_and_branch_from_the_code_root`).
- [ ] AC#2 — Each git/attribution store-repo site (compact_txn/rebuild/plan, fsck,
  fsck_tracker_health ×3, _proc.py detached_child_cwd, freshness.py:80) is routed through the
  single shared seam `rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker)` (behavior-preserving: the seam returns
  exactly `dirname(realpath(tracker))`, what these sites compute today) and the seam carries the
  `# repo-root-seam:` marker. VERIFY: `grep -rn 'store_repo_root' src/rebar` shows every store-repo
  site calls the seam; `python scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` is green. sync.py:305/307
  is already sanctioned (see above) — no action. No relocated-store behavior change, so no new
  oracle is required for these; behavior-preservation is covered by the existing store-command
  tests plus the guard.
- [ ] AC#3 — Extend `scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` to also flag the
  realpath()/abspath()-wrapped store argument AND `dirname(StorePaths(tracker).canonical)`
  (feisty-intense-mandrill's guard blind spot), so the guard is airtight for the whole class: the
  ONLY exempt spellings are the shared seam (`# repo-root-seam:`) and the already-sanctioned
  store-repo sites (`# repo-root-ok:`). Proven by the guard self-test
  (`tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py`) — the old "realpath/abspath NOT unwrapped"
  case is inverted, and `.canonical`/str-wrapped/seam-marker/single-seam cases are added.

## Testing

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py -q` — guard flags the realpath/abspath/.canonical variants; each reads.py config-read behavior change has a RED→GREEN oracle.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` — green on the fixed tree with all legitimate store-repo sites routed through the seam or sanctioned.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint && make typecheck` — no regressions.
